items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gene, when he got the gig – when Gene Perla got it, he said, “I’m going to get you and Grossman on it. Watch.” ... Sure enough, man, six months later, I get a call. ... I’m plus with Elvin Jones and his trio

ctx.x: You said you did – what? – 300 concerts?

The first year of our official stay at the – it was called the Space for Innovative Development, this renovated church I’m talking about. As I say, we were there with Alwin Nikolais Ballet, the Murray Louis Dance Company. It was prestigious, as I discovered. I didn’t know it then. But we were all into free jazz. Just to go aside now, the model for the music, for at least the people I was hanging with, was Ascension. We just wanted to play like that. The loft, these tapes I have, the most that went on in my loft…
